chunks: Everything in this book that is from al-‘Abbās ibn Hilāl, I have narrated it from al-Ḥusayn ibn Ibrāhīm ibn Nātānah—may Allah be pleased with him—from ‘Alī ibn Ibrāhīm, from his father, from al-‘Abbās ibn Hilāl.

key_terms.الْعَبَّاسِ بْنِ هِلَالٍ: A narrator from whom reports are transmitted here
key_terms.رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ: May Allah be pleased with him
key_terms.عَنْ أَبِيهِ: From his father, indicating a link in the sanad/isnad

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to al-‘Abbās ibn Hilāl in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage clarifies the sanad/isnad through which the author transmits narrations from al-‘Abbās ibn Hilāl in this book. Its significance lies in documenting the chain of transmission, which is essential in hadith preservation and evaluation.
